spans.s: अप्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, active, spacious; watery (?).

आप्त्य आप्त्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a class of
deities, and especially of the deity Trita, as one of
that class.

अप्त अप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. obs. rt. अप् for later
आप्), Ved. obtained; watery (?).

आप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reached, overtaken, equalled;
got, gained, obtained; reaching to, extending; abun-
dant, full; apt, fit, true, exact, clever, trusted, trust-
worthy, confidential; intimate, related, acquainted;
appointed; generally received; commonly used; au-
thentic; accused, prosecuted; (अस्), m. a fit person,
a credible person, a warranter, guarantee; a friend;
an Arhat; N. of a Nāga; (आ), f. a twisted band or
lock of hair; (अम्), n. a quotient; equation of a
degree.
—आप्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
gained his wish, satisfied.
—आप्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
managing things in a fit or confidential manner; (ई),
m. a trusty agent, a confidential servant.
—आप्त-
गर्भा, f. a pregnant woman.
—आप्त-गर्व, अस्, आ,
अम्, proud, arrogant.
—आप्त-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्,
having proper gifts, or furnished with gifts.
—आप्त-
वचन, अम्, n. received text, revelation, authority.
—आप्त-वज्र-सूचि, इस्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
—आप्त-वाक्य, अम्, n. a correct sentence.
—आप्त-
वाच्, क्, f. the evidence of a credible person; (क्), m.
one whose evidence is credible.
—आप्तोक्ति (˚त-उक्˚),
इस्, f. augment or affix; a word of received acceptation
and established by usage only.
आप्त, आप्ति, आप्तोक्ति, &c. See under rt. आप्.
अप्तस्, अस्, n. a sacrificial act.

अप्तु, उस्, m., Ved. busy, active, diligent; the
body; Soma; a sacrificial animal.

अप्तुर्, ऊस्, m., Ved. active, busy; giving water;
running as water.

अप्तूर्य, अम्, n., Ved. zeal, activity; the giving
of water.

अप्तोर्-याम, अस्, or अप्तोर्-यामन्, आ, m., Ved.,
N. of a sacrificial ceremony, and of a verse in the
Sāma-veda closing that ceremony [cf. वैराज].
आप्तोर्-याम, अस्, m. = अप्तोर्-याम, q. v.
आप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reached, obtainable.

आप्ति, इस्, f. reaching, meeting with; obtaining,
gain, acquisition; binding, connection, relation, fit-
ness, aptitude; (अयस्), f. pl., N. of twelve sacrificial
verses beginning with आपये (dat. case of आपि).
